objective: Continue pursuing a defensible advantage over applicable SOTA.
implementation: Use the actual first six physical pairs for a jointly calibrated perfect-separation gate; retain the original exact beta table through 512 discordances and use a higher threshold thereafter.
risk_scope: Both null and strict wrong-sign bounds are <=1 percent through 4096 physical shots under the stated independent-Bernoulli/common-ordering assumptions. This is not a hardware validation or an infinite-horizon guarantee.

geometric_metric.definition: Equal-case geometric mean of per-case unconditional mean paid-shot cost ratios over all 16 main cases.

arithmetic_cost.interpretation: Most gains occur in short strong-signal paths; the geometric percentage is not the percentage reduction in the total shot budget.

acceptance_audit.global_development_cost_improvement: Observed against every one of the 15 fixed implemented controls, using the prespecified geometric metric.
acceptance_audit.held_out_superiority: Not established. Candidate was refined using this development pilot.
acceptance_audit.95_percent_correct_stop_target: Not achieved: 462/512 = 90.234375 percent overall; weakest case is much lower.
acceptance_audit.universal_pathwise_dominance: Not proved. Later-D paths outside this development sample can be delayed by the higher threshold.
acceptance_audit.international_sota_or_novelty: Not established; exact sequential calibration and full-count e-values have classical precedents.

next_required: Improve the rare/weak-signal long paths that dominate total observations, while retaining adequate power.
Freeze a sufficient physical budget and independently evaluated cases/seeds; the H8192 boundary preparations are mathematical preparation, not a new experiment.
Match comparator optimization, including exact sequential and full-count methods, before formal superiority testing.
Preserve the full original international-leading objective and acceptance criteria.
